lastText: The Case Is ClosedA Quiet ArrangementNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56COLONEL MORAN LEAVES FOR THE EASTColonel Moran leaves Southampton on the Tuesday, with a valet, a trunk and an official escort who is careful not to call himself one. He will live in a comfortable house on an island in the Indian Ocean, with a good library and no rifle, for as long as it suits the Government to forget him. Nobody is tried. The Adair family is told that the case is closed. Lestrade shakes your hand on the stair, and does not look at you. It is a clean, grey, official ending, and it is not justice. You tell yourself that it is better than a scandal. You are not sure. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
